text_en: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit in the wilderness,
text_cn: 耶稣充满圣神，由约但河回来，就被圣神引到荒野里去了，

text_en: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing at all during those days, and when they were over, he was famished.
text_cn: 四十天的工夫受魔鬼试探；他在那日期内什么也没有吃，过了那日期就饿了。

text_en: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become a loaf of bread. ”
text_cn: 魔鬼对他说：“你若是天主子，命这块石头变成饼罢！”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “It is written, ‘One does not live by bread alone. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“经上记载：‘人生活不只靠饼。’”

text_en: Then the devil led him up and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
text_cn: 魔鬼引他到高处，顷刻间把普世万国指给他看，

text_en: And the devil said to him, “To you I will give their glory and all this authority; for it has been given over to me, and I give it to anyone I please.
text_cn: 并对他说：“这一切权势及其荣华，我都要给你，因为全交给我了；我愿意把它给谁，就给谁。

text_en: If you, then, will worship me, it will all be yours. ”
text_cn: 所以，你若是朝拜我，这一切都是你的。”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “It is written, ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve only him. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“经上记载：‘你要朝拜上主，你的天主；惟独奉侍他。’”

text_en: Then the devil took him to Jerusalem, and placed him on the pinnacle of the temple, saying to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down from here,
text_cn: 魔鬼又引他到耶路撒冷，把他放在圣殿顶上，向他说：“你若是天主子，从这里跳下去罢！

text_en: for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you, to protect you, ’
text_cn: 因为经上记载：‘他为你吩咐了自己的天使保护你，

text_en: and ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you will not dash your foot against a stone. ’”
text_cn: 他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚踫在石头上。’”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “It is said, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“经上说：‘不可试探上主，你的天主。’”

text_en: When the devil had finished every test, he departed from him until an opportune time.
text_cn: 魔鬼用尽了各种试探后，就离开了他，再等时机。

text_en: Then Jesus, filled with the power of the Spirit, returned to Galilee, and a report about him spread through all the surrounding country.
text_cn: 耶稣因圣神的德能，回到加里肋亚。他的名声传遍了临近各地。

text_en: He began to teach in their synagogues and was praised by everyone.
text_cn: 他在他们的会堂内施教，受到众人的称扬。

text_en: When he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, he went to the synagogue on the sabbath day, as was his custom. He stood up to read,
text_cn: 他来到了纳匝肋，自己曾受教养的地方；按他的习惯，就在安息日那天进了会堂，并站起来要诵读。

text_en: and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was given to him. He unrolled the scroll and found the place where it was written:
text_cn: 有人把《依撒意亚先知书》递给他；他遂展开书卷，找到了一处，上边写说：

text_en: “The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim release to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to let the oppressed go free,
text_cn: ‘上主的神临于我身上，因为他给我傅了油，派遣我向贫穷人传报喜讯，向俘虏宣告释放，向盲者宣告复明，使受压迫者获得自由，

text_en: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor. ”
text_cn: 宣布上主恩慈之年。’

text_en: And he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fixed on him.
text_cn: 他把书卷卷起来，交给侍役，就坐下了。会堂内众人的眼睛都注视着他。

text_en: Then he began to say to them, “Today this scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing. ”
text_cn: 他便开始对他们说：“你们刚才听过的这段圣经，今天应验了。”

text_en: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his mouth. They said, “Is not this Joseph’s son? ”
text_cn: 众人都称赞他，惊奇他口中所说的动听的话；并且说：“这不是若瑟的儿子吗？”

text_en: He said to them, “Doubtless you will quote to me this proverb, ‘Doctor, cure yourself! ’ And you will say, ‘Do here also in your hometown the things that we have heard you did at Capernaum. ’”
text_cn: 他回答他们说：“你们必定要对我说这句俗语：医生，医治你自己罢！我们听说你在葛法翁所行的一切，也在你的家乡这里行罢！”

text_en: And he said, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in the prophet’s hometown.
text_cn: 他又说：“我实在告诉你们：没有一个先知在本乡受悦纳的。

text_en: But the truth is, there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, and there was a severe famine over all the land;
text_cn: 我据实告诉你们：在厄里亚时代，天闭塞了三年零六个月，遍地起了大饥荒，在以色列原有许多寡妇，

text_en: yet Elijah was sent to none of them except to a widow at Zarephath in Sidon.
text_cn: 厄里亚并没有被派到她们中一个那里去，而只到了漆冬匝尔法特的一个寡妇那里。

text_en: There were also many lepers in Israel in the time of the prophet Elisha, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian. ”
text_cn: 在厄里叟先知时代，在以色列有许多癞病人，他们中没有一个得洁净的，只有叙利亚的纳阿曼。”

text_en: When they heard this, all in the synagogue were filled with rage.
text_cn: 在会堂中听见这话的人，都忿怒填胸，

text_en: They got up, drove him out of the town, and led him to the brow of the hill on which their town was built, so that they might hurl him off the cliff.
text_cn: 起来把他赶出城外，领他到了山崖上──他们的城是建在山上的──要把他推下去。

text_en: But he passed through the midst of them and went on his way.
text_cn: 他却由他们中间过去走了。

text_en: He went down to Capernaum, a city in Galilee, and was teaching them on the sabbath.
text_cn: 耶稣下到加里肋亚的葛法翁城，就在安息日教训人。

text_en: They were astounded at his teaching, because he spoke with authority.
text_cn: 人都十分惊奇他的教训，因为他的话具有一种权威。

text_en: In the synagogue there was a man who had the spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
text_cn: 在会堂里有一个附着邪魔恶鬼的人，他大声喊叫说：

text_en: “Let us alone! What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are, the Holy One of God. ”
text_cn: “啊！纳匝肋人耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来毁灭我们吗！我知道你是谁：是天主的圣者。”

text_en: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him! ” When the demon had thrown him down before them, he came out of him without having done him any harm.
text_cn: 耶稣叱（chì）责他说：“不要作声！从这人身上出去！”魔鬼把那人摔倒在人中间，便从他身上出去了，丝毫没有伤害他。

text_en: They were all amazed and kept saying to one another, “What kind of utterance is this? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and out they come! ”
text_cn: 遂有一种惊骇笼罩了众人，他们彼此谈论说：“这是什么事？他用权柄和能力命令邪魔，而他们竟出去了！”

text_en: And a report about him began to reach every place in the region.
text_cn: 他的名声便传遍了附近各地。

text_en: After leaving the synagogue he entered Simon’s house. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked him about her.
text_cn: 他从会堂里出来，进了西满的家。西满的岳母正发高热，他们为她祈求耶稣。

text_en: Then he stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she got up and began to serve them.
text_cn: 耶稣就走到她身边，叱退热症，热症就离开了她；她立刻起来服事他们。

text_en: As the sun was setting, all those who had any who were sick with various kinds of diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on each of them and cured them.
text_cn: 日落后，众人把所有患各种病症的，都领到他跟前，他就把手覆在每一个人身上，治好了他们。

text_en: Demons also came out of many, shouting, “You are the Son of God! ” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Messiah.
text_cn: 又有些从许多人身上出来的魔鬼呐喊说：“你是天主子！”他便叱责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是默西亚。

text_en: At daybreak he departed and went into a deserted place. And the crowds were looking for him; and when they reached him, they wanted to prevent him from leaving them.
text_cn: 天一亮，耶稣就出去到了荒野地方；群众就寻找他，一直来到他那里，挽留他不要离开他们。

text_en: But he said to them, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other cities also; for I was sent for this purpose. ”
text_cn: 他却向他们说：“我也必须向别的城传报天主国的喜讯，因为我被派遣，正是为了这事。”

text_en: So he continued proclaiming the message in the synagogues of Judea.
text_cn: 他就常在犹太的各会堂中宣讲。
